climate_pressure: May 2014 flooding and landslides; no event-specific anthropogenic attribution is asserted.
documented_impact: Water and slope movements displaced legacy mines/UXO into previously safe or suspected areas.
fcv_mediator: Conflict-era contamination and uncertain marking/survey status made reconstruction and farm access unsafe until professional survey and clearance.
possible_consequence: Potential accidents and restrictions on essential-service reconstruction and agricultural recovery; later delay duration is not established.
alternative_explanations: Direct flood damage and general reconstruction capacity also affect recovery.
Potential contamination estimates require professional verification.
uncertainty: Historical source-stated interaction and planned safety restrictions, not a current contamination map, clearance instruction or causal estimate of recovery delay.
resilience_factors: Professional mine-risk assessment, marking and clearance with coordinated recovery planning; reported response outputs are not proof that all land became safe.
compact_statement: Floods mobilized conflict-era mines/UXO, making recovery access contingent on professional survey and clearance in affected areas.

documented_impact: Affected households faced displacement, overcrowding and psychological distress.
fcv_mediator: Disrupted protection services and constrained survivor reporting can weaken safeguards.
possible_consequence: The rapid assessment anticipated possible increased GBV risk, not measured violence incidence.
geographies: flood-affected areas of Bosnia and Herzegovina
alternative_explanations: Pre-existing protection gaps, reporting access and household conditions affect risk independently.
Anticipation draws partly on other crises, not incident data from this event.
uncertainty: Historical anticipated risk, not verified harm, a current forecast or a nationally representative local assessment.
resilience_factors: Accessible survivor-centred services, safe shelter and mobile support can address stated gaps; effects not evaluated.
compact_statement: The 2024 flood assessment anticipated GBV risks through livelihood loss, crowding and disrupted protection services; no incidence increase was verified.
